Please quote Our Ref. as mentioned above in all communications with respect to this bid/contract. 2. The General Terms & Conditions of this proposed Order is as per Buyer Added Bid specific ATC clauses. 3. Technical Details & Supply Conditions are as follows: · Good Quality White Banian Teased Yarn Waste (Bleached) must conform to IS 5485:2022 for Type 1 Grade. · The material shall be free from dust, synthetic mix and other waste. · The material must be completely undeyed, unsized, and sourced exclusively from premium w hite banian manufacturing lines. The material must have a highly absorbent, soft hand-feel , ensuring it is entirely free from stiffness or chemical hardening. · Color Profile of the yarn waste shall be highly uniform, clean, Milky White / Bleached White. The presence of any colored threads, tinted fibers, or yellowish stains will result in immedi ate rejection of the lot. · The white banian yarn waste must be well-teased and machine-teased to provide a soft, hi gh-volume texture. It must offer maximum surface area for high liquid, oil, and grease abso rption. · Upon receipt of Purchase Order, the party shall provide proof of item before effecting bulk supply. Bulk supply shall be strictly as per PO terms and specifications, otherwise the suppl y shall be summarily rejected. · Our requirement is for 5000Kg White Banian Teased Yarn Waste. Each roll shall be packed i n suitable packing of 25kg net weight wrapped around with polythene sheets and weight of the roll should be marked legibly on each packets. 4.
